audit.whatIsWrong: breakdown.cooldowns names Karma's Focused Resolve (Tether) as the ability to track but gives no real number, just 'matchup-defining'.
audit.why: Focused Resolve is a flat 12s cooldown — worth stating since the whole 'all-in the moment her root is on cooldown' plan (already in content wants[]) is timed off that number.

Content win[] (Karma x5, Poppy x2) matches the packet levelChart exactly and both agree with the 53.26% Poppy-favored winrate over 1532 games in aggregate direction (Karma bullies the poke phase, Poppy takes over on a tank item) — no contradiction.

spikes[] correctly identify Karma's pre-6 poke spike (RQ isn't gated by level since Mantra is available from level 1), Poppy's first-tank-item walk-through spike, and the late teamfight flank/dive spike against an immobile, shieldless-vs-terrain Karma.
